newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd, P&O in container merger.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd, P&O in container merger.

text.p: Nedlloyd NV and Britain's Penninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company Plc said on Monday they planned a complete merger of their container shipping businesses.

The two companies said they would each take a 50 percent stake in the merged company, to be called P&O Nedlloyd Container Line, with Nedlloyd making a payment of $175 million to P&O to equalise the shareholdings.
"With a combined turnover of nearly $4.0 billion and a net asset value of some $1.5 billion, the new company will be one of the largest in world container shipping," a joint statement said.
P&O Nedlloyd will have an eight strong board, jointly chaired by Lord Sterling of P&O and Leo Berndsen of Nedlloyd.
It will begin operations no later than December 31, 1996, following due diligence and regulatory procedures.
